title: Meh - Bummed
text: Maybe it's just the Aug '20 box but it was really meh and I was bummed cause I was really looking forward to it. I remember reading a review where the lady said the stuff seemed for a younger person and she's not necessarily wrong. I wanted to give it once more chance but $40 is just too steep for what was in it so I'm just back to being bummed :(
